intro: How Machina was built, milestone by milestone. Each entry is what shipped and was committed that day, including what did not work.

entries.title: Foundation
items: Data-driven builders for fixed-wing aircraft, rotorcraft and tracked vehicles, with every part selectable
Explode view, deep links and generated airliners measured against their published size

entries.title: Original app design
items: The Hangar design system with dark, light and blueprint themes
Home page, category pages and gallery with 3D thumbnails, search and sort
Keyboard shortcuts, phone layout and accessibility work

entries.title: Real models
items: Open-licensed FlightGear aircraft loaded at runtime, with parts named from their meshes
Fifteen aircraft, X-ray view, a 1.8 m scale figure and a quality standard for listing a model
First parametric builder: a Boeing 737-300 lofted from published dimensions, then a Tu-154M measured from an open three-view drawing

entries.title: Drawings and generated detail
items: A3 three-view drawings projected from the 3D model as exact vectors, with sections, dimensions and a title block
Generated detail on parametric aircraft: panel seams, framed windows, control surface gaps, fan blades, gear linkage, antennas and beacons
Livery presets, then custom colors for any model whose livery can be recolored

entries.title: Mesh to parametric, and an accuracy benchmark
items: A converter that measures a detailed mesh into a parametric model with no per-model settings
A320neo, 787-8, 747-400 and 707 converted, scored 0.86 to 0.99 silhouette overlap against their source meshes
Light-aircraft rebuilds tried and kept unlisted: they came out worse than the originals

entries.title: Model page redesign
items: Livery palette in the viewer, a filterable parts rail with collapsed groups, and vertical tabs for overview, specs, drawing, sources and the selected part
Both side panels fold away as drawers to give the 3D view more room

entries.title: More aircraft, with their cockpits
items: Cockpits and cabins imported for the FlightGear aircraft, and simulator skins drawn on both sides so cabin walls show through the glass
Tupolev Tu-134A, Ilyushin Il-76TD and Concorde added, with airline titles and registrations painted out
Tu-154B-2, Tu-144D and Yak-40 kept unlisted: the Tupolevs store their landing gear folded and it could not yet be lowered correctly

entries.title: Validation gate
items: Every listed model must pass checks in the test suite: all wheels on the ground, no missing stretch along the length, nothing from the cabin outside the fuselage, and only textures a browser can load
Added after models were listed with floating gear, a missing nose cone and light-beam cones under the fuselage

entries.title: Public release
items: Open source at github.com/al-ex-ai/Machina and live at machina.al-ex.ai
A deploy is a git push: the server checks out the commit and stamps it onto every module URL, so Cloudflare serves fresh code

next: Milestone 1: a clean three-view drawing goes in and a model comes out, with no hand-written settings, its accuracy proved by the benchmark
Lower the Tu-154B and Tu-144D gear correctly and list them again
M3 Compare: two to four models side by side or overlaid at true scale
